name: Electrify Tech Camp
org: University of Michigan, Electrical and Computer Engineering
what_you_do: A summer day camp run by U-M engineers. You pick a topic like solar cells, chips, lasers, quantum, electric cars or AI. You do not need to know any of it first.
who_can_apply: High school students in 9th, 10th or 11th grade now. That means you will be a 10th, 11th or 12th grader in summer 2027.
pay_detail: $900 per camp. You pay only after you are accepted. Some full and partial scholarships are available.
duration: The camp pages do not say how long each camp is. It is a day camp with no housing.
deadline_text: The 2027 application date is not posted. Fill out the Electrify 2027 interest form to be told when it opens.
how_to_apply: Apply online and rank the camps you want. If accepted, pay the fee and send an information packet to keep your spot. The scholarship form comes after you are accepted.
notes: Spots are limited and you may not get your first choice. If you cancel, you get $850 back only if your spot is filled. The same group also runs an online coding class, The Joy of Coding.
